commands.command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 01db8228e6d822b5c64359abd8bf2d85341b5919; port=/dev/cu.usbserial-1130; test -e "$port"; python -c 'import serial,sys,time; s=serial.Serial(sys.argv[1],115200,timeout=.25); e=time.monotonic()+75; f=open("/tmp/eink-v7b.log","wb"); [(lambda d: f.write(d) if d else None)(s.read(4096)) for _ in iter(lambda: time.monotonic()<e, False)]; f.close(); s.close()' "$port"; tail -c 30000 /tmp/eink-v7b.log; grep -a 'Physical refresh completed generation=' /tmp/eink-v7b.log; ! grep -aEq 'Guru Meditation Error|Task watchdog got triggered|panic abort' /tmp/eink-v7b.log; git diff --check; test -z "$(git status --short)"
